WITH exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER 
    WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1 and DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) A
)

---BUSC List of Accounts for YTD ADB
WITH BUSC_Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    A.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= '2023-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('SBA','CAA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2023-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2023-01-27' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS  
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS
        END as AccountStatus
    ,A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DATEPART(dayofyear, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) AS DayOfYear
    ,(A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) AS YTDADB
        FROM (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE isActive = 1) A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) D ON D.ACID = A.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_CASAMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = A.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_TDMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) F ON F.ACID = A.ACID AND F.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        WHERE
            D.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(ACID)) AS ACID, COUNT(DISTINCT(FORACID)) AS FORACID FROM BUSC_Tally

---BNKM List of Accounts for YTD ADB
WITH BNKM_Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    A.CustomerAccountId, A.FinancialInstitutionId, B.BranchId, B.IsoCurrencyCode, C.ProductId, C.FcbsApplication
    ,CASE WHEN D.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' and B.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= '2023-01-27' and C.ProductId in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN D.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' and C.ProductId in ('SBA','CAA') THEN E.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
        WHEN D.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' and B.CustomerAccountClosedDate > '2023-01-27' and C.ProductId in ('CAA','SBA') THEN E.DepositAccountStatusTypeId 
        WHEN D.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' and B.CustomerAccountClosedDate > '2023-01-27' and C.ProductId in ('TDA') THEN E.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
        WHEN D.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' and C.ProductId in ('TDA') THEN E.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
        END as AccountStatus
    ,A.PeriodEndDate, A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance, DATEPART(dayofyear, A.PeriodEndDate) AS DayOfYear
    ,(A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, A.PeriodEndDate)) AS YTDADB
        FROM (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance') A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') C ON C.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND C.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CoreCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') D ON D.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND D.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN bnkm.DepositAccountStatus E ON E.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND E.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        WHERE C.ProductId NOT LIKE '09%'
)

DECLARE @date date

SET @date = '2023-01-27'
BEGIN
WITH exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER 
    WHERE isLatest = 1 and isActive = 1 and DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) A
)
,Tally AS (
    SELECT 
    A.ORGKEY, C.ACID, D.FORACID, A.BANK_ID, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.SCHM_CODE, D.SCHM_TYPE
    ,CASE WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('SBA','CAA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN E.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and D.ACCT_CLS_DATE > getdate() and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS  
        WHEN D.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and D.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN F.ACCT_STATUS
        END as AccountStatus
    ,C.CURRENT_EOD_DATE, C.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DATEPART(dayofyear, C.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) AS DayOfYear
    ,(C.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, C.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) AS YTDADB
        FROM (SELECT * FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) B ON B.CUST_ID = A.CORE_CUST_ID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES WHERE isActive = 1) C ON C.ACID = B.ACID AND C.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) D ON D.ACID = B.ACID AND D.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_CASAMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) E ON E.ACID = B.ACID AND E.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_TDMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1) F ON F.ACID = B.ACID AND F.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
)
,Tally_Distinct AS (
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT FORACID, BANK_ID, SOL_ID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, SCHM_CODE, SCHM_TYPE, AccountStatus, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DayOfYear, YTDADB
        FROM Tally GROUP BY FORACID, BANK_ID, SOL_ID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, SCHM_CODE, SCHM_TYPE, AccountStatus, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, DayOfYear, YTDADB) A
    WHERE FORACID NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)--- AND ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'USD'
    ---ORDER BY YTDADB DESC
)
,BUSC AS (
    SELECT B.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, (ISNULL(VAR_CRNCY_UNITS, 1.00) * A.YTDADB) AS 'buscYTDADB', A.*
    FROM Tally_Distinct A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE isLatest = 1 AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' AND RATECODE = 'REV' AND RTLIST_DATE = @date) B ON B.FXD_CRNCY_CODE = A.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE A.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' AND (A.AccountStatus <> 'Closed' OR A.AccountStatus IS NULL)
    AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = @date
    AND A.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'EUR'
)
,CustomerAccountParticipation_Latest AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SerialNumber ORDER BY PeriodStartDate DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipation
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    )
,CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_Latest AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SerialNumber ORDER BY Timestamp DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    )
,CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_Latest AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY PeriodStartDate DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    )
,DepositAccountStatus_Latest AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM bnkm.DepositAccountStatus
    )
,Tally_BNKM AS (
    SELECT 
    A.CustomerId, 
    B.CustomerAccountId, B.FinancialInstitutionId, E.BranchId, E.IsoCurrencyCode, F.ProductId ,F.FcbsApplication
    ,CASE WHEN G.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' and E.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= getdate() and F.FcbsApplication in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN G.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' and F.FcbsApplication in ('SBA','CAA') THEN H.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
        WHEN G.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' and E.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() and F.FcbsApplication in ('CAA','SBA') THEN H.DepositAccountStatusTypeId 
        WHEN G.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' and E.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() and F.FcbsApplication in ('TDA') THEN H.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
        WHEN G.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' and F.FcbsApplication in ('TDA') THEN H.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
        END as AccountStatus
    ,D.PeriodEndDate, D.AccumulatedCurrentBalance, DATEPART(dayofyear, D.PeriodEndDate) AS DayOfYear
    ,(D.AccumulatedCurrentBalance)/(DATEPART(dayofyear, D.PeriodEndDate)) AS YTDADB
        FROM (SELECT * FROM bnkm.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM') A
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM CustomerAccountParticipation_Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1) B ON B.CoreCustomerId = A.CoreCustomerId  AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1) C ON C.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND C.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND C.SerialNumber = B.SerialNumber
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance') D ON D.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND D.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') E ON E.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND E.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1) F ON F.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND F.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CoreCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') G ON G.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND G.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM DepositAccountStatus_Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1) H ON H.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND H.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
)
,Tally_Distinct_BNKM AS(
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, BranchId, IsoCurrencyCode, ProductId, FcbsApplication, AccountStatus, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance, DayOfYear, YTDADB
        FROM Tally_BNKM GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, BranchId, IsoCurrencyCode, ProductId, FcbsApplication, AccountStatus, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance, DayOfYear, YTDADB) A
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID) ---AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'USD'
    ---ORDER BY YTDADB DESC
)
,BNKM AS (
    SELECT B.ConversionRate, (ISNULL(B.ConversionRate, 1.00) * YTDADB) AS 'bnkmYTDADB', A.*
    FROM Tally_Distinct_BNKM A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = @date) B ON B.ConvertFromCurrencyId = A.IsoCurrencyCode AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE A.ProductId NOT LIKE '09%' AND A.AccountStatus != 'Closed'
    AND A.PeriodEndDate = @date 
    AND A.IsoCurrencyCode = 'EUR'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC A 
    LEFT JOIN BNKM B ON A.FORACID = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = B.PeriodEndDate
    WHERE A.buscYTDADB != B.bnkmYTDADB
END
